name: House Show

date.source: The post's own dateline; the broadcast is framed as previously recorded.

matches.note: A snowboard brought ringside by Musashi was confiscated by the referee before he finished the match with a top-rope finisher.
OCD drove Waldrop through a ringside timekeeper's bell with an inverted DDT, but Waldrop kicked out and finished with a top-rope frog splash and his own signature move.
Waldrop feigned injury to bait Hellbent into a false sense of security, then finished with a top-rope frog splash, a corner splash, and his own signature finisher.

The promotion's own live main event; Myles hit a top-rope hurricanrana before Answer ran in to attack him, and Chris Kitching and Jeremy Rhodes then ran in behind their own partners, ending the match with no decision and setting up a tag match for the promotion's own Gulf Coast Championship.

evidence.source: The promotion's own first show, now served in full.
evidence.note: Three recapped matches and a live main event ending in a no-contest run-in that sets up a title tag match.

notes: The promotion's own first show, opened in person by its own on-screen owner. The live main event between the promotion's own two headliners ends in a four-man run-in with no decision, setting up a Gulf Coast Championship tag match for the following week's Sunday Night Rebels (previewed, but not itself in the held record with results).
